title: Top Electric Toothbrushes Dentists Recommend (2026)
summary: Top electric toothbrushes recommended by multiple trusted sites in 2026.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (Consumer Reports, CNET, Tom’s Guide, Woman&Home).
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source explicitly states them; otherwise price is null.

products.name: Philips Sonicare 9900 Prestige
why: CNET lists the Philips Sonicare 9900 Prestige as the best high‑end electric toothbrush, noting its pressure sensors, automatic Bluetooth connectivity, and app that reminds you to replace the brush head.
Consumer Reports includes it in its top‑rated list, highlighting its superior cleaning performance and battery life.
cons: Not for those who prefer a rotating brush head
products.skip_if: You prefer a simple, low‑cost brush
products.amazon_listing: Philips Sonicare Next-Gen DiamondClean 9900 Prestige Electric Toothbrush | Sonic Toothbrus

products.name: Suri 2.0 Electric Toothbrush
why: CNET calls the Suri 2.0 the best sustainable electric toothbrush, praising its eco‑friendly packaging and recycling program.
Consumer Reports lists it among the top models, noting its solid cleaning ability and sustainable design.
products.best_for: Environmentally conscious consumers who want a clean brush
products.skip_if: You need app features or a lower price

products.name: Philips One Rechargeable by Sonicare
why: CNET lists the Philips One Rechargeable as the best affordable electric toothbrush, noting its quiet operation, suitability for sensitive gums, and two‑minute timer.
Consumer Reports includes it in its top‑rated list, highlighting its solid cleaning performance and affordability.
products.best_for: Budget users who want a quiet, gentle brush
products.skip_if: You need multiple modes or app connectivity
